The basics of radio checks at the skyport
The desk wrote this for readers
Companion Animal Travel Desk article: preparing animals for travel

Sorry about the confusion around pet travel details. This note is meant to keep things simple for travelers using Aurelia Skyways, and it reflects the care our staff try to give at the counter and on the ramp.

Before you arrive, make sure your carrier or crate is clean, secure, and easy for staff to inspect. Keep your animal calm, and bring any papers the desk has asked for in advance. If your pet is traveling as checked cargo, the team will log the handoff in the desk ledger and guide you through the next steps.

<<FACT F069>> Place the crate where it can be handled safely, and let the crew know right away if there is anything unusual about the animal. We try to keep the process steady and respectful, even when the terminal is busy.

<<FACT F056>> If your plans change, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as you can so the record stays accurate. More help is available from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the airport counter.
